risks.risk: Unit may be a stock photo or not available for sale

proof_requests: Video of the generator starting and running with load.
Photo of the internal stator or windings to verify copper construction.
Photo of the serial number and any labels on the unit.

response.reason: The model and brand are clearly visible, but critical claims about copper coils and engine condition cannot be verified from the current photo. The image appears to be a stock photo, raising fraud concerns. Proof of working condition and material quality is needed before pricing.
